name: Anantara Al Jabal Al Akhdar Resort
insider_take: Perched dramatically on Oman's highest peak at 6,000 feet, this clifftop sanctuary offers breathtaking canyon views and refreshing mountain air in the heart of the Arabian Peninsula's rugged beauty.
whats_special: The resort sits on the rim of a spectacular canyon in the Al Hajar Mountains, making it the highest luxury resort in the Middle East. The property features traditional Omani stone architecture that blends seamlessly with the dramatic landscape, while offering activities like via ferrata rock climbing and stargazing in one of the region's clearest skies.
pro_tip: Visit during October to March for perfect hiking weather, and don't miss the sunrise yoga sessions on the cliff edge – the mountain air is up to 20 degrees cooler than the coast.
dont_miss: The ancient terraced rose gardens of Jabal Akhdar bloom from March to May, producing the precious Damascus roses used in Omani rose water. Take the thrilling zipline across the canyon, and explore nearby Nizwa's historic fort and traditional souq, famous for its silver jewelry and frankincense.
pros: Dramatic clifftop location with breathtaking mountain and canyon views
Luxury mountain retreat offering unique highland desert experience
World-class spa and wellness facilities in stunning natural setting
Exceptional dining experiences showcasing local and international cuisine
cons: Remote mountain location requires scenic but lengthy drive to reach
Limited nearby attractions outside of resort activities
